text_block_list.text:
After our outing, as I walked Special Week 
back to her dorm—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, today was so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Going out together with you, Trainer, 
somehow feels really special.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'm just a little bit more nervous than 
when I go out with my mom or my friends, 
so...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Of course I don't mean that in a bad 
way!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"If anything, it's because I'm so happy 
that I'm nervous... sort of! I-I can't 
really explain it well, though..."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Me and Ma would go help out at the field 
across the way, and stuff...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Besides that, I'd also do things like 
deliver the neighborhood circular to the 
grandma next door.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, huh? Is this... going out on an 
outing?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
No, even if it's not a special place, as 
long as it's fun, it counts as a proper 
outing, right? Hehe!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Umm~, like El-chan taking me to an 
ultra-spicy restaurant—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Like going to take on giant-portion ramen 
with King-chan, or...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, all I've been doing is 
eating...!? Awa-wa, that's so 
embarrassing...
